item.title: Hugo vs Other Static Site Generators: Why I Chose Hugo
item.description:
When building this blog, I evaluated several static site generators. Here’s why I ultimately chose Hugo.

The Contenders

I considered these popular options:

  1. Hugo - Go-based SSG
  2. Jekyll - Ruby-based, GitHub Pages default
  3. Next.js - React-based framework with SSG support
  4. Gatsby - React-based SSG focused on GraphQL

Comparison Matrix

Feature Hugo Jekyll Next.js Gatsby
Build Speed ⚡ Fastest Slow Medium Slow
Learning Curve Low Low Medium High
Plugins Limited Many Many Many
Tech Stack Go Ruby React React
Bundle Size Minimal Minimal Large Large

Why Hugo Won

1. Speed

Hugo is ridiculously fast. Building thousands of pages takes seconds, not minutes:

item.title: Understanding Python Decorators: A Practical Guide
item.description:
Python decorators are a powerful feature that allows you to modify or enhance functions and methods. Let’s dive into how they work and when to use them.

What Are Decorators?

A decorator is a function that takes another function as input and extends its behavior without explicitly modifying it. They’re commonly used for:

  • Logging
  • Authentication/authorization
  • Caching/memoization
  • Rate limiting
  • Input validation

item.title: Welcome to My Tech Blog
item.description:
Welcome to my new tech blog! This is the first post in what I hope will be a long series of articles about software development, tutorials, and technical insights.

Why Another Tech Blog?

The internet is full of tech blogs, so why create another one? A few reasons:

  1. Personal learning - Writing about technical topics helps solidify understanding
  2. Sharing knowledge - If I struggled with something, others might too
  3. Building a portfolio - Demonstrating expertise through writing
  4. Community contribution - Giving back to the developer community
